purpose: 用户明确授权的森林五秒分层图片＋FFmpeg样片；不是六类正式交付

prompts.background: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE clean background plate for a first-person, calm forest entrance animation assembled later with separate transparent foreground layers. Wide landscape canvas around 3:2 (target 1920 by 1248 composition). Camera at human eye level, level horizon, natural 35mm lens, looking along a gently winding EARTH FOREST PATH into a small softly illuminated clearing at center x=50%, y=48%. Real temperate broadleaf woodland, mossy rocks, fern beds beside the path, slender straight tree trunks primarily at middle and far distances, delicate canopy overhead. Morning sunlight from upper left filtered by leaves, sage and moss greens, warm brown earth, realistic fine bark and leaf texture, atmospheric depth, moderate contrast, soft natural color, tranquil meditation setting. Keep central path clearly visible from bottom center into the clearing; forest floor must cover entire bottom edge. NO large close-up trees, NO close-up fern fronds obscuring frame edges: these will be added as separate parallax layers. This plate must be completely filled with believable forest scenery, suitable for small camera push-in without revealing an empty border. Documentary-quality natural photography, no illustration, no CGI look, no dreamy artificial fog or HDR glow. No people, no bodies, no animals, no buildings, no typography, no watermark, no collage, no panels. Render a single beautiful high-resolution forest photograph.
prompts.trees: Use case: photorealistic-natural compositing layer. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting/style/perspective reference for a calm forest entrance. Create ONE separate near-tree parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Landscape canvas same 3:2 framing as the reference. Draw ONLY two photorealistic living broadleaf tree trunks and a few attached leaves: one medium close tree rooted beyond the bottom edge in the outer LEFT 10-15% of the frame, and one thinner tree rooted beyond the bottom edge in outer RIGHT 8-12%. Both trunks extend past the TOP and BOTTOM canvas edges. They should gently frame an entirely EMPTY and TRANSPARENT central 65% corridor. Detailed dark warm bark with muted moss near the bottom, sunlight striking from upper LEFT exactly like reference. Very sparse small branches near the upper OUTER corners only; never bridge across the center. No ground plane, no rocks, no distant trees, no forest background, no sky, no cast shadow plate, no border, no checkerboard painted into the image. Everything except the two framing trunks and their small attached leaves must have actual alpha transparency. Match the photographic material realism, moderate contrast and morning color of the reference, so the layer can be composited over that forest photograph and enlarged a little to create camera parallax. No people, no animals, no text, no watermark. One full-canvas layer, not an illustration of layers and not a collage.
prompts.ferns: Use case: photorealistic-natural compositing layer. Reference image 1 is ONLY the photographic lighting, color, eye-level perspective and natural texture reference. Generate ONE near-ground fern foliage layer with genuine RGBA TRANSPARENCY, full wide landscape canvas around 3:2. Draw only two organic clumps of real woodland fern fronds growing from beyond the bottom LEFT and bottom RIGHT canvas corners. Left clump fills about outer 22 percent of width and lower 30 percent of height, right clump outer 18 percent and lower 25 percent; fronds point slightly inward and upward, with a few leaves reaching near lower side edges. Keep the CENTRAL 60 percent of the whole image and ENTIRE upper 65 percent COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT, allowing a forest path behind to remain unobstructed. Photorealistic delicate green fern leaflets, slightly darker moss green in shade with small warm morning highlights from upper left; soft natural fine leaf texture and realistic irregular stems, not shiny plastic and not sharp silhouetted clipart. Ground/root ends continue off the bottom edge so nothing floats. Every pixel except the actual fronds and stems is transparent: no forest background, no ground plane, no moss carpet, no rocks, no sky, no fake checkerboard, no opaque solid background, no vignette. Near ferns should have a subtle photographic depth-of-field softness so they frame a more distant sharp forest scene. No figures, no animals, no text or watermark. Single full-canvas transparent compositing plate, not a collage.
